title: Ruthless Bar Salts Strawnana 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Strawnana brings together the soft, summery sweetness of ripe Strawberries and the rich, creamy smoothness of Banana, creating a flavour that’s fresh, fruity and indulgently smooth. The strawberries deliver a juicy, authentic sweetness up front, followed by the mellow, velvety depth of banana for a well-rounded and deeply satisfying vape. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, offering a balance of full-bodied flavour and silky-smooth vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a silky throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption. Ruthless has long been at the forefront of the US vaping industry, creating bold and distinctive shortfill and nic salt e-liquids that stand apart from the rest. Their dedication to innovative flavour blends and premium-quality ingredients continues to push the boundaries of what’s possible in e-liquid.
